about.title: About Me
about.content: Dedicated Naval Architecture graduate with 3+ years of experience in marine surveying, quality control, and project supervision in the petroleum, welding, and maritime industries. Skilled in inspections, report creation, non-destructive testing, and technical software. Proven ability to manage projects from start to end, including docking surveys, repair planning, and QC witnessing.
